facts.value: The MSc is open to learners who have already completed two Professional Diplomas or 60 ECTS Credits at Level 9 in areas such as aviation, operations management, ICT, artificial intelligence, data analytics, supply chain, or regulatory affairs.
The programme also supports Recognised Prior Learning for applicants who may have only one Professional Diploma but have a minimum of 5 years relevant work experience.
To pursue an undergraduate engineering degree in India, students must complete their 10+2 in the Science stream from a recognised board.
For postgraduate courses, a bachelor’s degree in engineering with a minimum of 50 per cent marks is required.
Candidates must have a Bachelor's degree in Engineering, such as B.E. or B.Tech, with at least 60 percent.

facts.value: Candidates are usually required to qualify in a recognised entrance examination for admission to postgraduate engineering programmes.
